og.title: Gentlemen of Letters - A Dublin Sign Painting Film
og.description: Dublin has a rich history of hand painted signs decorating the city. Although it is not as common today, the craft still continues.   To view work by the sign writers and artists featured in the documentary visit the links below: Kevin Freeney - http://www.flickr.com/photos/gentlemanofletters Colm O' Connor - http://www.colmoconnorsignwriter.com Maser - http://maserart.com/ James Earley - http://www.inputout.com/ Kevin Freeney Jr - http://www.kevinfreeney.com  Also check out Film Makers Tal
